items.title: [VIA] Dining in the Dark Experience (Sign up)
items.author: Wang Jingwei
items.description:
HEY HWA CHONG!! 👋 VIA Council is thrilled to announce our latest batch project, Love Through Our Lens! 🫰🏻
In collaboration with Guide Dogs Singapore, we aim to bridge the gap between the visually impaired community and the student body by creating shared experiences that foster empathy and understanding alongside creating meaningful activities for the visually impaired! 🤩
So how can YOU take part?
On 1st September, VIA Council will be hosting Dining In The Dark in the Common Room from 1600 - 1730! Come down and take part in a series of activities such as:
👀 A different way of experiencing food: Put on a blindfold, rely on your other senses, and see if you can guess our mystery food samples!
🧩 Hands-on challenges: Try out simple everyday tasks while experiencing different forms of visual impairment!
💬 Learn & connect: Hear more about the experiences of persons with visual impairments and the ways they navigate everyday life, while reflecting on how we can make our spaces more inclusive.
So what are you waiting for? Sign up now through this form
https://forms.gle/SAPxKDc5hR3m4naH9
to be part of inclusive and enriching activities!
PS: I heard that there are attractive prizes to be won! 😉
With that, VIA Council warmly welcomes you to our Dining in the Dark Experience! See you there! ✨
With much much love,
VIA Council 26/27 🩵💛
